Build a modern, fun, mobile-first web app called:

🎓 “Student Survival App” 🧑🎓🔥

Tagline:
“Survive college. One deadline at a time. 😂”

The app should feel like it was made BY students, FOR students — useful, colorful, modern, funny, and slightly chaotic.

IMPORTANT:
- Make the app fully functional, not just a static UI.
- Make it responsive for mobile, tablet, and laptop.
- Use clean component-based structure.
- Add smooth animations and interactive buttons.
- Use localStorage so user data remains after refreshing.
- No backend is required for the basic version.
- Use realistic sample data on first launch.
- The uploaded image called “Life of a Student” must be used as the main visual identity of the application.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🖼️ APP IMAGE / VISUAL IDENTITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use the uploaded “Life of a Student” image throughout the application.

The image shows a notebook-style illustration with the title:
“LIFE OF A STUDENT”

Use this SAME image in two ways:

1. APP ICON / LOGO
- Use the uploaded image as the application logo/icon.
- Create a clean circular or rounded-square crop of the image for the logo.
- Show it on the login page.
- Show it in the top navigation/header.
- Use it as the favicon/app icon where technically possible.
- On mobile, use the cropped image as the app icon.

2. BACKGROUND
- Use the uploaded image as the main background visual.
- Do NOT stretch or distort the image.
- Use it as a full-screen background with:
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
  background-attachment: fixed where supported.
- Add a dark/translucent overlay over the image so text remains easy to read.
- Use glassmorphism cards on top of the background.
- The image should remain recognizable behind the UI.
- On small mobile screens, intelligently position/crop the image so the important “LIFE OF A STUDENT” illustration remains visible.

Do NOT replace the uploaded image with another image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏳ APP LOADING SCREEN
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Before showing the login page, create an animated loading/splash screen.

Show:

[Uploaded Life of a Student image/logo]

🎓 Student Survival App

“Loading your academic survival kit...”

Add a smooth loading animation/progress indicator.

While loading, randomly display funny student messages such as:

“📚 Finding your motivation... ERROR 404.”

“☕ Brewing academic survival mode...”

“😭 Checking how many assignments you forgot...”

“🧠 Waking up your last remaining brain cell...”

“📅 Calculating how badly you're behind...”

“🚨 Detecting upcoming deadlines...”

“😴 Checking whether you should sleep or study...”

“📚 Loading syllabus... Please don't panic.”

“☕ Connecting to caffeine server...”

“🎓 Preparing your survival mode...”

Show one message at a time with a smooth fade animation.

Loading should last approximately 2–3 seconds and then smoothly transition to the login page.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔐 1. LOGIN / WELCOME PAGE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create a beautiful modern login page using the uploaded image as the background and logo.

Center a glassmorphism login card.

At the top:

[Life of a Student image/logo]

🎓 Student Survival App

“Survive college. One deadline at a time. 😂”

Fields:

👤 Student Name
📧 Email

Optional:
🔒 Password

Buttons:

🚀 Enter Survival Mode

Also provide:

“Continue as Guest”

For the basic version, do NOT require a real backend authentication system.

Use localStorage to remember the student's name/login state.

After login, show:

“Welcome back, [Student Name]! 👋”

Add a small funny message:

“Your assignments missed you. 😭”

or

“Ready to survive another day? 🔥”

Include:

☑ Remember me

If the user has already logged in before, automatically remember the name and provide:

“Welcome back!”

Also include a logout option in the profile/settings area.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎨 DESIGN & UI
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Main theme:

- Use the uploaded Life of a Student image as the visual theme.
- Dark overlay over background.
- Glassmorphism cards.
- Rounded corners.
- Subtle gradients.
- Smooth animations.
- Modern typography.
- Fun emojis.
- Clean spacing.
- Professional enough for a college project.
- Fun enough to feel like a student-made app.

Use translucent cards so the background image can still be seen.

Top header:

[Small Life of a Student logo]

🎓 Student Survival App

“Because college is already hard enough 😭”

Navigation:

🏠 Home
📊 Attendance
📝 Assignments
🍔 Canteen
📅 Timetable
⏳ Exams

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🏠 2. HOME DASHBOARD
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create a dashboard showing:

“Hey [Student Name]! 👋
Ready to survive today?”

Display cards for:

📊 Attendance

Example:
Overall Attendance: 78%

“⚠️ Attend a few more classes!”

📝 Assignments

Example:
3 assignments pending

Next deadline:
DBMS — 2 days left

🍔 Canteen

⏳ Next Exam

Java Exam

12 days 6 hours remaining

😂 SHOULD I SLEEP OR STUDY?

When clicked, randomly show funny responses:

“📚 STUDY! Your exam is closer than you think.”

“😴 SLEEP! Your brain has officially submitted a leave application.”

“☕ 30 minutes study → 10 minutes break → repeat.”

“🚨 PANIC LEVEL: Academic. Start studying now.”

“😴 Sleep. Tomorrow-you will thank you.”

Add a fun animation when the result appears.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📊 3. ATTENDANCE CALCULATOR
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create an attendance calculator.

Allow students to enter:

Subject
Total classes conducted
Classes attended

Calculate:

Attendance % =
(Classes Attended / Total Classes) × 100

Show a visual progress bar.

Status:

🟢 Safe: 75% or above
🟡 Warning: 65%–74%
🔴 Danger: below 65%

Also calculate:

“How many classes can I miss?”

and

“How many classes do I need to attend to reach 75%?”

Example:

DBMS
Classes: 40
Attended: 32
Attendance: 80%

Status:
🟢 Safe

Create an assignment manager.

Subjects:

DBMS
Data Structures (DS)

Value Added Course (VAC)
OOP / Java
Computer Organization & Architecture (COA)

Allow:

Assignment title
Subject
Due date
Priority

Display:

🔥 Due today
⚠️ 2 days left
🟢 7 days left
✅ Completed

Sort assignments by nearest deadline.

Buttons:

➕ Add Assignment
✅ Mark Complete
🗑️ Delete

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🍔 5. CANTEEN STATUS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🍔 CANTEEN STATUS

Opening hours:

08:00 AM – 06:00 PM

🍜 Maggi — ₹40

Funny messages:

OPEN:
“🍔 Your wallet is in danger.”

CLOSED:
“😭 RIP. Survive until tomorrow.”

Allow an OPEN/CLOSED toggle.

Days:

Monday

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create this as one of the main features.

Large animated card:

“Should I Sleep or Study?”

Button:

😂 ASK THE SURVIVAL AI

Generate responses based on upcoming exams and assignments.

Examples:

“📚 STUDY! Your exam is coming.”

“😴 SLEEP! A tired brain learns nothing.”

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

On mobile use bottom navigation:

🏠 Home

Add smooth page transitions.

Attendance
